## Writer identification with a CNN

<!-- Task 2: build and evaluate a CNN with writer ID as the response; overall and per-digit performance; what the measures mean in real-world terms. -->

```{r}
#| label: cnn-cache

cnn_results_file <- "results/cnn_cv.rds"
cnn_retrain <- !file.exists(cnn_results_file)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-setup
#| eval: !expr cnn_retrain

library(keras3)
use_backend("tensorflow")
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-preprocess
#| eval: !expr cnn_retrain

# Scale pixel values to 0,1
x <- handwriting$images / 255

y <- to_categorical(handwriting$metadata$person_id - 1, 20) #needs classes numbered from 0
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-define
#| eval: !expr cnn_retrain

# Each fold needs a new model with fresh weights, so the model is built by a function
build_cnn <- function() {
  input <- layer_input(shape = c(28, 28, 1))

  # Ian's model structure taken from lecture slides
  output <- input %>%
    layer_conv_2d(filters = 16, kernel_size = c(3,3)) %>%
    layer_activation('relu') %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.20) %>%
    layer_conv_2d(filters = 16, kernel_size = c(3,3), activation = "relu") %>%
    layer_max_pooling_2d(pool_size = c(2, 2)) %>%
    layer_flatten() %>%
    layer_dense(units = 20, activation = 'softmax')

  model <- keras_model(inputs = input, outputs = output)

  model %>% compile(
    loss = 'categorical_crossentropy',
    optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 0.01),
    metrics = c('accuracy'),
  )

  model
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-fit
#| eval: !expr cnn_retrain

# 5-fold cross-validation by session: train on four sessions, hold out the fifth
cnn_epochs <- 5
cnn_history <- list()
cnn_predictions <- list()

for (fold in 1:5) {
  train_id <- which(handwriting$metadata$session != fold)
  test_id <- which(handwriting$metadata$session == fold)

  x_train <- x[train_id,,,,drop = FALSE]
  y_train <- y[train_id,]
  x_test <- x[test_id,,,,drop = FALSE]
  y_test <- y[test_id,]

  set_random_seed(67)
  model <- build_cnn()

  history <- model %>% fit(
    x_train, y_train,
    epochs = cnn_epochs, batch_size = 8192,
    validation_data = list(x_test, y_test), shuffle = TRUE,
    verbose = 0
  )

  y_test_hat <- model %>% predict(x_test, verbose = 0) %>% op_argmax(axis = 2) %>% as.numeric()

  cnn_history[[fold]] <- tibble(fold = fold, epoch = 1:cnn_epochs,
                                train = history$metrics$accuracy,
                                held_out = history$metrics$val_accuracy)
  cnn_predictions[[fold]] <- as_tibble(handwriting$metadata[test_id,]) %>%
    mutate(fold = fold, predicted = y_test_hat)
}

# Save everything the rest of this section needs
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(list(summary = capture.output(print(build_cnn())), # untrained copy, so only the model's own parameters are counted
             history = bind_rows(cnn_history),
             predictions = bind_rows(cnn_predictions)),
        cnn_results_file)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-load

cnn_results <- readRDS(cnn_results_file)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-summary

cat(cnn_results$summary, sep = "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-history

# One line per fold
cnn_results$history %>%
  pivot_longer(c(train, held_out), names_to = "data", values_to = "accuracy") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = epoch, y = accuracy, colour = data, group = interaction(data, fold))) +
  geom_line() +
  ylim(0, 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-evaluate

# Accuracy on the held-out session of each fold
cnn_folds <- cnn_results$predictions %>%
  group_by(fold) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), accuracy = mean(person_id == predicted))
cnn_folds

# Cross-validated accuracy
cnn_folds %>% summarise(mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy), sd_accuracy = sd(accuracy))
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-confusion

# Every image is predicted once, by the model that did not see its session
y_test_original <- cnn_results$predictions$person_id
y_test_hat <- cnn_results$predictions$predicted
table(y_test_original, y_test_hat)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-by-digit

cnn_results$predictions %>%
  group_by(digit, person_id) %>%
  summarise(accuracy = mean(person_id == predicted)) %>%
  arrange(desc(accuracy))
```
